archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-races
archetypes.rationale: Changed guideline-note pinning and diff snapshot code should be checked for residual race windows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the architectural guideline note pinning and diff materialization changes. Check whether closeout now performs a single current-head pin attempt without dropping valid post-merge behavior. Verify that the frozen HEAD SHA is reused consistently for merge-base and diff while preserving existing failure semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
